import json,collections
r=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')]; a=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
for x,s in zip(r[85:],['ъъъь','ъьъ','ьъъ','ъьь','ъъ','ьъ','ьъ','ь','ьъ']):
 a.append(dict(item_id=x['item_id'],slots={str(i+1):c for i,c in enumerate(s)},confidence={str(i+1):'high' for i in range(len(s))},unmarked_final_hard_signs=[],pre1918='yes',note=''))
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for x in a:f.write(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
a=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(a)==len(r)
for x,y in zip(r,a):
 assert x['item_id']==y['item_id']
 expected={str(i+1) for i in range(x['slots'])}
 assert set(y['slots'])==expected
 assert set(y['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(v in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for v in y['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in ['high','low'] for v in y['confidence'].values())
 assert y['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
print('Validated count, order and slot coverage:',len(a),'items')
print('Slot calls:',dict(collections.Counter(v for y in a for v in y['slots'].values())))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(y['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for y in a))
